name: Yamaha FZR600 / FZR1000
engine: 599 or 989 cc liquid-cooled inline four, four carbs, EXUP valve on the 1000
intro: Yamaha's late 80s and 90s sport fours. Four carbs, a Deltabox frame and on the 1000 an EXUP exhaust valve that seizes.

add.title: Free the EXUP valve (FZR1000)
add.instructions: Remove the EXUP cover on the collector, check the valve turns freely and the cables are adjusted. Clean and grease it if it is stuck.
add.reason: A seized EXUP valve kills midrange power and can strain the servo.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
